risks.title: Foot Locker Integration and Restructuring Costs
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly states estimated pre-tax acquisition-related charges of $500 to $750 million, with $390 million already incurred in fiscal 2025. Integration is central to near-term financial performance and represents a material existential challenge if poorly executed. The risk is new and high intensity. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Foot Locker integration carries substantial restructuring costs ($500-750M estimated) including inventory write-downs, store closures, and merger integration expenses, threatening near-term profitability.

risks.title: Foot Locker International Sales Decline
risks.score_rationale: Pro forma comparable sales declined 3.3% overall, with International markets showing -8.1% decline in Europe and Asia Pacific per the 10-K. This represents significant competitive pressure in key markets. The trend is concerning but management indicates turnaround initiatives are underway. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Foot Locker International comparable sales declining sharply at -8.1%, indicating loss of competitiveness and demand weakness in Europe and Asia Pacific markets.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Inflationary Pressures
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly cites elevated interest rates, inflationary pressures, changes to international trade policies, tariffs, and geopolitical conflicts as ongoing headwinds affecting consumer discretionary spending and the promotional landscape. These factors are repeatedly mentioned with cautious language. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Dynamic macroeconomic environment with elevated interest rates, inflation, trade policy uncertainty, and geopolitical tensions pressuring consumer discretionary spending on sports products.

risks.title: Foot Locker Store Portfolio Optimization and Closures
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K references an ongoing review of unproductive assets across Foot Locker's store portfolio and mentions anticipated store closures as part of optimization efforts. This implies material restructuring costs and operational disruption. The risk is in motion and escalating. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Optimization of Foot Locker store portfolio involving closures of unproductive locations drives restructuring costs and operational complexity.

risks.title: Strategic Brand Partnership Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K emphasizes strong relationships with key brand partners as essential to accessing differentiated products and maintaining competitiveness. Any disruption to these partnerships could undermine the company's differentiation strategy. Risk is structural but stable. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competitive positioning depends on maintaining strong relationships with key athletic brand partners for access to exclusive and differentiated product assortments.

risks.title: Digital Platform Security and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company operates multiple digital platforms including GameChanger (youth sports mobile platform), DICK'S Media Network, and eCommerce channels that collect consumer and operational data. While not explicitly detailed in risk disclosure, the expansion of digital services creates implicit cybersecurity exposure. Risk is emerging. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Expansion of digital platforms (GameChanger, DICK'S Media Network, eCommerce) increases exposure to cybersecurity threats and data breach risks.
